capacity_details.notes: TECfusions states 3 GW total campus capacity and 1 GW leased today on its current site page. Its January 14, 2026 release describes an initial 10 MW TensorWave Keystone Connect deployment scheduled for H1 2026 and a multi-phase path to 1 GW. The January 14, 2025 acquisition release claimed 12 MW immediately available.

urls.summary: Westmoreland County Resolution R-69-2025 for TECfusions KEYSTONE, LLC RACP cooperation agreement.
Current TECfusions New Kensington page: 1,395-acre site, 3 GW total capacity, 1 GW leased, on-site microgrid generation.
TECfusions/TensorWave announcement: initial 10 MW Keystone Connect deployment scheduled for H1 2026; multi-phase path toward 1 GW.
Acquisition of 1,395 acres in Upper Burrell, former Alcoa R&D campus, planned 3 GW over six years, 12 MW immediately available.
Local reporting on Building J permit/status, first two phases, moratorium applicability, and lack of long-term plan documents in RTK response.
Regional reporting that Upper Burrell approved a 180-day moratorium, while existing TECfusions interior work was not stopped.

contradictions.details: Sources describe multiple capacity layers: 3 GW planned total, 1 GW leased claimed on TECfusions' current site page, 10 MW initial TensorWave deployment scheduled for H1 2026, and 12 MW immediately available claimed in January 2025. Treat 3 GW as planned buildout and 10 MW as specifically announced initial customer deployment until energized/live evidence is found.

Local media reports Building J interior work and existing-building activity, but no directly accessible township permit record was found during this refresh. Broader campus expansion remains subject to local ordinance/moratorium process.
